title: How AI coding tools are contributing to the popularity of JavaScript
summary: TypeScript surpassed all other languages to become the most used language on GitHub in August 2025, marking the largest shift in language rankings in a decade. This unexpected surge occurred precisely when AI coding agents were being widely adopted, contradicting earlier predictions that AI would diminish the importance of language selection.
problem_solved: It addresses the unexpected paradox that AI coding tools, rather than reducing the importance of language choice, have actually accelerated the adoption of TypeScript/JavaScript.
why_valuable: This insight reveals how AI coding assistants are reshaping developer preferences and language ecosystems, with major implications for technology stack decisions.
